We will review our room setup procedures to help ensure that necessary items are available in advance, especially for scheduled baby checks.

We understand your concern about the examination surface. Your baby’s safety is always our priority, and we regret any moment during the consultation that felt unsafe or uncoordinated.

We also want to reassure you that all NHS GPs are trained to carry out 6-week baby checks as part of their core training. This is a normal part of providing safe, collaborative care.

We understand your interest in seeing a GP who specialises in baby health. While there is no separate paediatric specialist role within general practice for routine checks such as the 6-week baby check, we can reassure you that all NHS GPs are fully trained to carry these out. If you prefer to see a different GP, our reception team can do their best to accommodate this depending on appointment availability.

Thank you again for your feedback. We’re glad to hear you felt the doctor was kind and caring, and we will certainly use your comments to help improve the experience for families attending baby checks in the future.
